Strategy presentation

Before the tests, watch a short live demonstration of how our operators work.

At Sigma Dynamix, operators do not decide when to trade: our systems do. When conditions match the firm's strategy, an authorization signal lights up. Your job is to choose the direction — buy or sell — and execute, quickly and consistently. Every position is protected by an automatic 70-tick trailing stop.

Taking every signal is mandatory. Your evaluation compares you with other operators on the same signals, so a skipped signal cannot be scored and counts against you.

You choose the direction on every signal. The order panel shows two buttons, BUY and SELL. You open one position per signal: as soon as you enter, both buttons lock until the next signal.

What makes a good trade is your entry price. If the market drops after the authorization, wait for the dip and buy; if it pushes higher, wait for the push and sell. Never chase a move that is already running. Always wait for your price.

The demo replays a real NQ market moment and shows two examples: one buy, one sell. Watching it in full is required before the tests.

Did you understand everything?

You can rewatch the demo if anything is unclear — otherwise, continue to the trading tests.
